utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but could you tell me the exact drop-off time and what items they’ll accept first?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still catching up on the repair drive details, but I can check the drop-off time and accepted items for you. If you want, I’ll get back to you with the exact list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that’d help a lot—please check the exact drop-off time and the accepted items first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check in and come back with the latest—last I heard, they still needed a few hand tools and some sturdy boxes for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll pass that along and start asking around for the hand tools and boxes right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Quinn—thanks for spreading the word. I’ll keep listening and let you know if I hear they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds like sorting donations and pickup coordination are the big needs—want me to pass that along to anyone nearby?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, please pass that along—sorting donations and pickup coordination would be a huge help. I’ll send the repair drive details over so everyone can work around the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely—I’ll pass it along to folks nearby and keep an ear out for anyone who can help. Thanks, Jules.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan so folks don’t miss it, and I’ll let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep it quiet and can still swing by late if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and remind folks to bring what they can. If anything changes, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for the details before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, send me the details when you have them and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do — I’m still waiting on the repair drive details, then I’ll send them your way for a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re in good shape, but we still need a few more hands for sorting donations and coordinating pickups. If you know anyone who can spare an hour or two, send them my way!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’re saying it’s mainly sorting and pickups now? I just want to hear exactly what you still need before I take that at face value.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — mostly sorting donations and coordinating pickups right now, and a few extra hands would really help. I can send the full repair list and timing so you can see exactly what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—let’s keep it simple and steady. Tell me the plan, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’ll start by gathering tools and spare parts, then I’ll see if I can round up a couple volunteers. We can keep it simple and steady.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Sam. I’ll stay on the plan and wait for your update.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I still need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye. What details do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Just the basics: what time and place, what you’re collecting, and whether there are any specific supplies or hand tools still needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Opal. I’m going to write down the repair drive list now so I don’t forget anything else.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll start at the community center lot and let you know if it isn’t there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep the list here and head over if I think of anything else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can grab heavy-duty tape and a few replacement screws while I’m out. If you remember the size, send it along and I’ll make sure to get the right ones.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I think the screws were the medium ones, but I may be mixing that up. If I hear the exact size, I’ll send it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect — send the exact size if you get it, and I’ll grab the tape and screws on my errands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need two paint cans, if you can spare them. I’ll keep the tally updated and mark down the rest after that.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair drive details right over now, and I’ll note the two paint cans on the tally.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Mara — I’ll add the two paint cans to the tally and wait for the rest of the details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdriver, and tape over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, Gus — that covers a lot. I’ll keep lining up a couple volunteers and check for any extra spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll keep those tools ready and bring them over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and reminding folks to bring whatever they can. If I hear anything new, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Vik — thank you. We’re still especially looking for a few more people for sorting and pickups, so anyone you send our way will make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating that we still need folks for sorting and pickups, and I’ll send anyone your way who can help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me—let’s keep it simple and steady. Tell me the plan, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me—just keep me as a maybe for now, and I’ll confirm once I’ve checked my schedule.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s fine by me—just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll keep the plan steady.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. Quiet is best for me right now, but I appreciate you checking in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — I’ll keep it quiet. If you hear of anyone who can help with the repair drive, just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I will — I’ll keep an ear out and send anyone your way if I hear of them. Thanks for keeping it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m still trying to remember the screw size—give me a minute and I’ll jot it down if it comes back to me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That’s fine, but let’s confirm the screw size before we assume anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Kira — I’m still digging it out of my memory, but I’ll check my notes and tell you as soon as I find the right size.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring basic tools, gloves, and whatever spare screws or tape I have. Just tell me where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo — that helps a lot. Bring what you can, and I’ll check on the screws and see how many paint cans are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just send me the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can send you the repair drive details now—what would be most helpful for you to know?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly what’s still needed and where to drop things off—if there’s a specific list, send that too and I’ll grab what I can while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the needed items and the drop-off spot, plus the full list if I have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdriver, and tape over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — that’s perfect. I’ll send the repair drive details right over now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll keep an eye out for the details and bring the hammer, screwdriver, and tape over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—let’s mark down any tools, wood, and screws first, then I’ll note whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. We still need a hammer, screwdriver, and tape on the list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll add the hammer, screwdriver, and tape to my list. If you think of anything else missing, let me know and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — I’ll check the community center lot first and let you know if it’s not there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, thanks — if it’s not there, I’ll check around and see what else they still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’ll start there and report back if I don’t find it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping me posted. I’ll try not to miss the updates this time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted, and I’m starting with Maple Street so the word goes out fast.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate it. Maple Street sounds like a good place to start, and I’ll try to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds great — I can help gather tools and spare parts, and I might be able to round up a couple volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be really helpful, Sam — thank you. If you can send me the repair drive details, I’ll work the school schedule around it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll send over the repair drive details so you can fit it around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can do that — I’ll stay quiet and can swing by late if you still need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll hold off until I have the repair drive details, then I’ll let you know if I need help.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll keep it quiet and wait for your update.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
